snippet.title: [STEAM] Withdrawal Official Trailer
snippet.description:
A roguelike fast paced FPS heist. You play as Mr. (?) Norton on his way to kill all the people in the tower of Cranterry Wealth Corp. Your task, as mentioned, is to kill the CEO of the company Maxwell Adams.

Wishlist it now...
